result.summary: The home screen is mostly coherent, but one restaurant card in the Fastest section has its name clipped by the viewport, and a loading spinner sits on top of a Popular card without a clear loading state.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in Fastest near you (Trattoria Piccol…) is cut off on the right so the restaurant name is incomplete, not just a peek of the next carousel item.
issues.suggestion: Give horizontal cards enough inset or wrapping so titles stay fully readable, or show an ellipsis only after a complete last word.

issues.description: A circular loading spinner overlays the Tokumaru Ramen Bar image while the rest of that card (title, rating, delivery info) is already fully rendered, which looks like a stuck or misplaced loader.
issues.suggestion: Show a skeleton or spinner for the whole card until image and metadata are ready, or hide the spinner once the card content is visible.
